Why most people use the wrong success recipe.

Kevin Trudeau says that if you asked him how to improve your finances, he wouldn't hand you an app, an AI program or a crypto course. He says real success starts when you program what you want into your subconscious mind.

He points out that people read books, go to seminars and watch videos, yet every teacher forgets the one most powerful ingredient. Kevin's blunt verdict: most people are using the wrong recipe.

Which recipe are you following right now?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

You know your name instantly. Why not what you want?

Kevin Trudeau says the first step to success is answering one question: what do you want? He notes you can say your name, phone number and address without thinking, but when he asks what you want, most people have to stop and think.

He calls that the number one error. Saying you want more money is vague, and he says your desire must be specific.

Could you answer that question right now, out loud?

#ad #goals #success #kevintrudeau

Your dreams may be too small to ever work.

Kevin Trudeau tells you to think so big it would take three lifetimes to accomplish. Use your imagination like a kid who wanted to fly like Superman, and picture the things you want.

He says that if you never expand your imagination, nothing else he teaches will work. He points to the classic book The Magic of Thinking Big.

When did you last let yourself dream without limits?
